convention:
THE OWNER CONVENTION (coordinator's executive ruling at Bryce's request, 2026-10-22): the owner is the entity whose
variable the number sets.
 1. has / earns / spends / is / does N -> that entity; the DOER owns a count of its own actions (Christian mowed 4 yards -> Christian;
    Jeannie hikes 12 miles -> Jeannie; they have one week -> Jesse and Mia).
 2. a property of a SPECIFIC object belongs to that object (the tank costs $100 -> the tank; the first class has 20 students ->
    the first class; a wall measuring 7 by 8 feet -> that wall).
 3. a change with no agent belongs to the container whose state changes (7 pens are removed from the jar -> the jar).
 4. a comparative belongs to the group it counts (8 fewer trombone players -> the trombone players).
 5. NONE: unit definitions inside a compound modifier (30-pound crates, 8-ounce carton, 30-hour workweek), per-unit rates and
    recipes (5 beads per earring), percentages and multipliers (50% more), ordinals and non-quantities.
 6. pronouns are resolved to the named entity; a transfer's quantity belongs to the receiver.
